The '''Cave of Shadows''' was an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tomb on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] that was located in the [[Malignant Bog]]. A powerful [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] could be summoned using a ritual and Sith runes in the cave.
